name: Visconti Seizure of Milan
summary: Archbishop Ottone Visconti defeated the della Torre family at the Battle of Desio in 1277, establishing Visconti dominance over Milan. The Visconti transformed Milan from a commune into a Signoria, rule by a single lord. Over the following century, the Visconti expanded Milanese power across Lombardy and Piedmont, making it one of the most powerful states in Italy.
outcomes: Ottone Visconti defeats della Torre family
Milan becomes leading north Italian power

_quarry.structural_significance: Exemplified the broader Italian transition from communal self-government to Signoria; Milan became a model for the Italian principate.
